text.value: Laboratory Report

tr.th: Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:

tr.td: The patient shows significant hypoxemia, mild anemia, leukopenia, mild thrombocytopenia, lymphopenia, monocytosis, and elevated basophils. There is also mild renal impairment (elevated creatinine), hyperchloremia, and mildly elevated ALT. These findings may indicate acute or chronic hypoxic and inflammatory processes, possible infection, and early renal and hepatic involvement. Clinical correlation and further investigation are recommended.
